decisions.reason: After surviving the first post-launch review and gaining a dedicated page, the GIS platform looks strategically central to the firm's consulting business, so its option value remains high relative to the cost of keeping it available.

The field data capture product also survived beyond launch, but mobile software typically carries higher maintenance demands and faces more uncertain standalone demand, so we would keep it while viewing it as the most at-risk of the three.

The 2019 version update is a clear positive signal of continued development, and as a modular search extension for web map applications it is a relatively cheap option to keep open while supporting the firm's GIS product ecosystem.
